map.Reach 和 Impressions（曝光）有什么区别？: What is the difference between Reach and Impressions?
map.Impressions 是总展示次数（含同一人被多次看到），Reach 是不重复: Impressions is the total number of displays (including repeat exposures to the same person), while Reach is the share of people who saw it at least once. With the same 2 million impressions, if they concentrate on a few people, Reach is low and frequency is high; if spread out, the opposite. The two must be read together to judge coverage quality.
map.频次设上限有什么用？: What is the point of a frequency cap?
map.频次上限（Frequency Cap）防止同一用户对同一广告看得过多产生厌烦或浪: A frequency cap prevents the same user from seeing the same ad too many times, which causes annoyance or wastes budget. Three to five times per cycle is common, balancing memorization against harassment, and the media strategy is authoritative.
